# Yomitan fixtures

`yomitan.py` builds small Yomitan zips for the reader tests. `JMDICT_ROWS` and `JMDICT_TAGS` are
a handful of rows copied from the JMdict Yomitan release (`JMdict_english`).

JMdict is the property of the Electronic Dictionary Research and Development Group (EDRDG) and
is used under the Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike licence. See https://www.edrdg.org/.
